scope: Local Windows x64 JIT and actual generated .NET/TypeScript package consumers. Original DSH source tests/cross-runtime differential, Linux, Native AOT, hosted CI, browser rendering, Maker, source-archive builds and remote SourceLink retrieval were not run for this checkpoint.

gitSourceComparison.rule: The frozen report hashes actual working-tree bytes. Non-C# differences are solely CRLF/LF under the repository text=auto eol=lf rule; all C# sources match Git blobs exactly.

dotnetSettingsDeclarationsAndManagement.managementToolchain: explicit fixture toolchain with actual prepared files; SDK execution is covered separately

completedConsumerInputs.selection: Author/caller sources, projects and contracts; emitted model/client inputs and assets; actual restored Cordis archive/metadata bytes. Raw inputs remain private.

retainedFailedCheckpoints.failure: Compatibility change observation threw on an unreadable compatibility file before the existing grant authority could return its safe refusal.
retainedFailedCheckpoints.correction: Observe unknown compatibility bytes distinctly from absence; retain the original non-authorizing, non-rewritable policy and strengthen its existing primary regression.

retainedFailedCheckpoints.failure: The frozen candidate had not received the required canonical formatting check; the check found 21 layout differences.
retainedFailedCheckpoints.correction: Apply token-preserving formatting; all four stages agree on the repaired candidate.

retainedCollectionFailure.failure: The first collector assumed every working-tree hash equals an unfiltered Git blob. Seven non-C# files differ solely in CRLF/LF representation.
retainedCollectionFailure.correction: Keep actual frozen hashes, verify Git normalization separately and require exact bytes for all C# sources. No runtime, package or source bytes were changed.

otherNonAcceptanceRuns: Trial consumer feeds exposed required nullable field omission and an absent CLI PluginManager mount; both were corrected before the frozen gate.
A standalone verifier self-test run used the wrong SDK search path; the unchanged 38 tests passed with the pinned SDK.
